# figures/

## Included in this repo

- `fig1_arch.{pdf,svg,png}` - combined method figure: (a) model architecture,
  (b) self-consistency training. Generated by `scripts/draw_fig_arch.py`.
- `fig1a_model.{pdf,svg,png}` - standalone architecture panel.
- `fig1c_consistency.{pdf,svg,png}` - standalone self-consistency panel.

## Generated by the notebooks (not stored in git)

Result figures are rebuilt from result files, so they are not versioned.

| Figure | Produced by |
|---|---|
| Curriculum schedule with measured regime shares | `notebooks/revision/rev17_figures.ipynb` |
| IoU by availability regime (all-pixel and flood-only) | `rev17_figures.ipynb` |
| Accuracy vs parameter count | `rev17_figures.ipynb` |
| Paired differences with event-blocked intervals | `rev17_figures.ipynb` |
| Partial-cloud curves | `rev17_figures.ipynb` |
| Qualitative examples, failure cases (chips with water only) | `rev17_figures.ipynb` |
| Original-version figures (degradation, Pareto, dataset overview) | `notebooks/11_final_results.ipynb`, `notebooks/12_paper_figures.ipynb` |

`scripts/plot_curriculum.py` regenerates the schedule plot standalone.
Figures that show satellite imagery contain modified Copernicus Sentinel data
and Sen1Floods11 labels; cite Bonafilia et al. (2020).
